approved_episodes.title: Snowy Night Studio | 1 Hour of Lo-Fi Jazzhop for Coding

reference_brief.setting: Rustic log cabin at night. Stone fireplace with a lively orange fire on the left, terracotta jugs and a small woven basket on the mantel, a cream knitted blanket over the chair behind her. A large dark-framed window on the right shows snowy mountains under a deep blue night sky, pine trees and steadily falling snow.
reference_brief.cat_pose: Lying in a loaf on the table, front paws tucked, tail hanging off the right edge.
reference_brief.palette: Amber and orange firelight inside against cobalt and navy snow light outside.
reference_brief.light: Firelight from the left, cool moonlit snow from the window; static period.

approved_episodes.title: Autumn Bookshop Coding | 1 Hour of Lo-Fi Jazzhop for Coding

reference_brief.setting: Corner table of a cosy bookshop on a rainy autumn evening. Brass desk lamp switched on at the far left, shelves of orange and brown books behind her, a window top-left framing a branch of orange maple leaves, and a large window on the right onto a wet cobblestone street with a lamppost and a glowing shopfront in the rain.
props: leaf-pattern cream mug on a coaster (foreground left)
reference_brief.cat_pose: Sitting upright on the table by the window, tail hanging down the front edge.
reference_brief.palette: Burnt orange, rust and warm wood inside; slate grey and muted teal rain outside.
reference_brief.light: Warm lamp pool from the left, grey rainy daylight from the window.

approved_episodes.title: Greenhouse Rain Study | 1 Hour of Lo-Fi Jazzhop for Coding

reference_brief.setting: Glass greenhouse study during rain. Green-tinted glass roof and walls with rain streaks, strings of warm hanging bulbs, large ferns framing left and right, potted plants and background desks with books and small candles.
props: background desks with books and candles
plain cream mug with brown rim (foreground left)
reference_brief.cat_pose: Lying curled on the table to the right of the laptop, tail along the table.
reference_brief.palette: Emerald and teal glass and foliage around a golden, honey-lit table.
reference_brief.light: Soft rainy daylight through glass plus warm bulb glow; static period.

canonical_identity.source: Described from the approved source stills (sha256 in files.source) on 2026-10-16; the stills remain the authority.
canonical_identity.style: Painterly anime-influenced lo-fi illustration, 16:9, soft warm interior light against a cooler exterior, gentle grain, clean readable shapes; no text, logos or watermarks.
canonical_identity.girl: Young adult woman with voluminous shoulder-length dark brown curly hair, warm light skin, brown eyes and a calm soft smile, gaze lowered to the laptop. Black over-ear headphones with bronze rims. Oversized moss/olive-green chunky knit cardigan over a dark charcoal top, thin delicate necklace with a small pendant. Sits on a dark wooden chair, both hands on the keyboard.
canonical_identity.cat: Grey-brown tabby with dark stripes, white chest, muzzle and paws, green eyes, long ringed striped tail often hanging over the table edge. Calm and still; lives on the table to the right of the laptop.
canonical_identity.composition: Camera locked at seated table height. Girl left of centre (about 20-45% width), dark grey laptop seen from the back at centre-right (about 37-72%), cat at the right (about 78-95%), a large window or glass wall on the right half, warm wooden table across the bottom third, a ceramic mug in the lower-left foreground.
